summary: In the white space of the Construct, a jump program rushes up beneath Morpheus and Neo until they are standing on a rooftop in a city skyline. Morpheus tells Neo to "Let it all go... Fear. Doubt. Disbelief. Free your mind," then runs hard at the edge and jumps, sailing across the street to land on the rooftop opposite. Neo reacts with "Shit," looks down at the street twenty floors below and at Morpheus fifty feet away, mutters "Okie dokie. Free my mind. Right. No problem," takes a deep breath, and starts to run.

what_changes.before: Hesitant and daunted by the jump, reacting with disbelief.
what_changes.after: Steeled and ready to attempt the leap himself.
what_changes.evidence: NEO: Shit. ... He takes a deep breath. And starts to run.

what_changes.before: Standing beside Neo on the rooftop, coaching him.
what_changes.after: Across the street on the opposite rooftop, having demonstrated the jump.
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus spins, running hard at the edge of the rooftop. And jumps.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus demonstrates the jump program and Neo prepares to follow.

uncertain: Whether Neo successfully completes the jump.
Whether Morpheus intended the demonstration as a test or simply an example.
